notes.title: DEMO v1.12 Version Update
DEMO v1.11 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Based on the feedback we received, we have fixed the performance issues in the DEMO 1.1 trial version and released the v1.11 update. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by the issues in the previous version.Please update the game to get the latest version. 

- Fixed an issue where some users were unable to play the "Samurai Sword Drawing Pattern" mini-game

If you encounter any new game issues, please contact us at support@lspsp.me. Thank you for your support and understanding.

notes.title: DEMO v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Based on the feedback we received, we have optimized the DEMO version and released the v1.1 update. Please update the game to get the latest version.


 Added a start hint message and increased the countdown time in the samurai sword pattern drawing mini-game
 Changed the menu in the upper right corner of the story screen so that it no longer auto-hides


If you encounter any new game issues, please contact us at support@lspsp.me. Thank you for your support and understanding.

notes.title: 🐍 Bond in 2025
notes.content:
Dear Players:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/276020a1d019016a88b32be3cd63b4d2fc5a83c1.png

Happy New Year!
In 2025, the Year of the Snake, our game "Spiritual Bond" will launch both its demo and full release.
To celebrate this special year of connection, we present this greeting illustration and wish you all:


⛩️ 金蛇献瑞，财源滚滚；(Prosperity as the golden snake brings blessings;)
⛩️ 龙蛇共舞，吉星高照；(Harmony as the dragon and snake dance together;)
⛩️ 蛇行九天，好运常伴；(Luck always accompanying you, like a serpent soaring through the skies;)
⛩️ 步步高升，前程似锦！(Step by step to success and a bright future!)

Let’s meet in 2025 and forge a spiritual bond!

notes.title: ❁༑ LSP 2025 Spring Festival Themed Event ༑❁
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/adc61a6fad4abec6d725124595b4e5171aa81094.jpg

Dear players:

To celebrate the upcoming 2025 Year of the Snake, our mascot has prepared festive activities filled with benefits. We wish all LSP players a joyful Spring Festival holiday and a prosperous New Year!

· •● Spring Festival Sale & Benefit Bundles ●• · 
Big discounts to bid farewell to the old year, collect a set to welcome the New Year

The Spring Festival holiday is here, the perfect time to stay home and enjoy some visual novels! From January 17 to January 31 (the third day of the Lunar New Year), LSP brings you an all-out sale of our published titles. Purchase the Benefit Bundle to catch up on all 2024 releases and stack discounts up to 51% off individual items!

❙　Visit the Sale Page: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/LSPGAL/list/139525

Grab the nine new titles released by LSP last year (collect the full set) and enjoy a 30% bundle discount. Combined with the Spring Festival sale, you can save up to ¥105. You’ll also get a chance to participate in a limited-time red envelope event for completing the set. It's time to let our mascot spread some gold coins! >口<

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49373/

· •● LSP Lucky Draw for New Year Gifts ●• · 
200 Themed Window Decals & ¥2025 Red Envelopes

From now until the Lantern Festival, the LSP Lucky Draw will feature a Spring Festival welfare lottery event, giving out the mascot's first New Year gifts for the Year of the Snake—

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/c0410a7e8f138e880f1eec8bc7b4d9e88e6f8c32.png
【January 17 - January 20】200 sets of "Year of the Snake Spring Festival Themed Window Decals" and random merch from LoveStore will be given away. Half of these will be available through the V3 exclusive lottery. Gifts will be delivered before the Spring Festival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/9ff30bfef9d52f5f214e9e80546319e53ebb4555.png
【January 27 - February 12】105 red envelopes worth ¥5 each and 20 red envelopes worth ¥50 each, totaling ¥2025, will be distributed. The ¥5 red envelopes are open to all, while the ¥50 envelopes are exclusive to players who own all games in the "Spring Festival Benefit Bundle." Winners will be announced on the Lantern Festival.

❙　Claim Your Gifts: https://www.lspsp.me/lottery

We look forward to your participation. Good luck!
